items.summary: In an internal test, Google DeepMind robotics researchers instructed Gemini 4 Argon to watch a video of a human playing cornhole. items.title: Benchmark LLMs on your own transcripts with Voice Standard Bench
items.summary: General LLM leaderboards score coding, math and chat. None of them score what a model does with a real transcript: the filler words, missing punctuation and misheard names that come out of Speech-to-Text. Voice Standard Bench does. In this video we clone it, point it at a folder of our own audio, and get back a leaderboard for those transcripts. Voice Standard Bench scores every model on AssemblyAI's LLM Gateway, 50+ today, on the tasks voice products hand to an LLM: summarization, information extraction, text correction and dictation cleanup. Each task runs at four transcript lengths, from a 30-second voicemail to an hour-long meeting. Every model gets the same transcripts and the same prompt. Two judge models score each answer against a fixed rubric, and the run logs every format failure, refusal and timeout. Quality, response time and cost per hour of audio are reported side by side. The published results are the starting point.
